enabled.description: Whether to enable gamemode globally for user sessions.

governor.description: CPU frequency governor to switch to in performance mode (e.g., 'performance', 'powersave').

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to online during performance mode (0 = all cores).

allowlist.description: List of path prefixes to consider as games. Paths matching these will trigger performance mode.

denylist.description: List of path prefixes to exclude from game detection.

use_pstate.description: Enable Intel P-State driver in performance mode (if supported).

enable_gpu_boost.description: Enable GPU frequency boost (e.g., NVIDIA X server settings or AMD PPLIB) when gaming.

gpu_boost_freq.description: Target GPU boost frequency in MHz (0 = use driver default).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of game process inactivity before returning to normal mode.

proc_priority.description: Nice value to assign to game processes (e.g., -10 for higher priority).

gpu_configs.description: Per-GPU device performance configurations (one per device).

device_path.description: Sysfs path to GPU device control directory.

boost_freq.description: GPU boost frequency in MHz for this device (0 = driver default).

pstate_mode.description: Enable Intel P-State for this device (NVIDIA/AMD GPUs may ignore).
